summary: Voice button data-state is now `transcribing` after stop (it stayed `recording`), and the recording bar's stop button has its own name (`voiceStopAndInsertAriaLabel`, "Stop and insert text").
howTo: An own selector or test on `[data-component="voice-input-addon"][data-state="recording"]` (or `voice-input-button`) no longer matches between stop and the arriving text: add `[data-state="transcribing"]` where the recording look or wait should cover it (the stock styles do). States: idle, connecting, recording, transcribing, failed. A test or locator that finds the recording bar's stop by the name "Stop recording" / "Aufnahme beenden" now finds only the mic button; use "Stop and insert text" / "Beenden und Text übernehmen" or `[data-component="recording-bar"]`. An own locale table can set `voiceStopAndInsertAriaLabel`. Details: skills/building-glirastes-chat-ui/references/hooks-and-building-blocks.md (Speech worklet).
